bear_assumptions: FY2028 revenue of USD 460 million at 5x enterprise value to revenue as RPO conversion or margin execution weakens; USD 170.8 million net cash after note principal and investment; 385 million diluted shares including equity awards.
base_assumptions: FY2028 revenue of USD 540 million at 10x enterprise value to revenue as recurring demand supports growth but capital intensity persists; USD 270.8 million net cash; 395 million diluted shares including RSUs, options and other dilution.
bull_assumptions: FY2028 revenue of USD 620 million at 18x enterprise value to revenue as retention, RPO conversion, margins and free cash flow improve; USD 680.8 million gross cash after investment; 427 million diluted shares including net convertible, option and RSU dilution.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a lower price or higher current primary-evidence revenue and cash-flow path clears expected-return, base-return, downside-payoff and margin-of-safety gates; downgrade the operating thesis if RPO conversion, retention, guidance, satellite reliability, government funding, liquidity or per-share economics weaken.
